aiAssist.budget.title: Isabelomali seseshini
aiAssist.budget.hint: Ngomkhawulo obekiwe, sonke isicelo esithunyelwa ku-Claude siqhathaniswa nesabelomali esisele ngaphambi kokuba siphume. Uma singase seqe umkhawulo asithunyelwa futhi uyatshelwa ukuthi kungani. Ezingxoxweni zokusiza ungaqhubeka “okwalesi sikhathi esisodwa kuphela”; ezinye izici ze-AI ezifana nengxoxo zidinga umkhawulo uphakanyiswe noma ususwe. Inombolo yalo mkhawulo kuphela egcinwa kulesi siphequluli.

aiAssist.managed.failureValue: Uma i-AI eyodwa imatasa noma isifinyelele emkhawulweni wayo, isicelo sidluliselwa ku-AI elandelayo ngaphambi kokuthi kubhalwe noma iyiphi impendulo. Uma ingekho etholakalayo uyabona ukuthi kungani, bese unquma ukuthi uzame futhi yini.
aiAssist.managed.failureShort: Uma i-AI eyodwa imatasa, elandelayo iyathatha.
aiAssist.managed.loginHint: Ngena ngemvume ukuze usebenzise lokhu ngaphandle kokhiye; khona-ke kuzosebenza ngokushesha ku-ToonStudio AI. Uma ukhiye wakho ubhalisiwe, ungakusebenzisa ngaphandle kokungena ngemvume.
aiAssist.episodic.title: Episode AI assist · Script-based editorial suggestions
aiAssist.episodic.readerBasis: Based on your script · No audience analytics
aiAssist.episodic.scopeNotice: Reviews up to four panels or transitions using the first 600 script characters. Local examples are not AI results; AI suggestions are not audience analytics or a full manuscript inspection.
aiAssist.episodic.failed: The AI review could not finish. Check your sign-in and AI connection, then retry. Local examples are not a new analysis.
aiAssist.episodic.stopped: AI review stopped. Results from the stopped request will not be applied.
aiAssist.episodic.exampleComments: Illustrative reader reactions · Not actual comments
aiAssist.episodic.noGuarantee: Continuity suggestions · Cannot guarantee zero errors
